response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT status, project_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT status, project_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
